panel.summary: Datasource create/update responses return the encrypted password blob unmasked, unlike the read endpoints
panel.evidence: `findAllByWorkspace` (line 66-69) and `findOne` (line 77) deliberately replace `password` with `'********'`, but `create` (line 44-57) and `update` (line 95-98) return the raw Prisma record, so the API response includes the full `iv:authTag:ciphertext` AES-GCM payload (crypto.util.ts:37-41) for any workspace member who creates or edits a datasource. That hands out material for offline attack should `DATASOURCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY` ever leak, and defeats the masking applied everywhere else. Reached via the endpoints at datasource.controller.ts:43, 67, 104; relevant because this change adds the user-facing documentation for the feature.
panel.finding_key: packages/backend/src/datasource/datasource.service.ts::datasource create/update responses return the encrypted password blob unmasked, unlike the read endpoints
